title: resourceDatabase
responsibility: Opens the shared private SQLite protocol with equivalent Bun and Node statement adapters.

inputs.name: resourceDatabase.home
inputs.description: Filesystem directory containing this queue SQLite database and validated reserve configuration.

outputs.name: resourceDatabase
outputs.description: Open database implementing the common transaction and statement protocol.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Unsupported database versions and filesystem or SQLite errors reject without resetting the existing queue.
